findings.text: note (non-blocking): the `suite_collection` stub fails first, so under a regression the `launched == [] and temporary == []` assertions never see a recorded entry. With the old filter order simulated, both git-only tests went red on the stub's `pytest.fail` alone; the subprocess and temporary-directory spies guard only routes outside `suite_collection` and have not been shown red.
findings.fix: In `test_recompute_ordinary_files_git_only_valid` only, record the `suite_collection` call and delegate to the real function instead of calling `pytest.fail`, then assert the record is empty beside the two spy lists. A regression then fails on the observed pytest launch and temporary directory, with no test added.

findings.text: adversary (pre-existing, not introduced here): git_maybe strips stdout, so leading blank lines are dropped before the 20-line concern window is counted; a file with 20 blank lines then a concern line on line 21 is treated as carrying a concern.
